mapper.sql: id, case_no, title, category, sub_category, region, county_code, county_name, street_code, street_name, content, measure_plan, measure_result, source, status, vector_id, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warning_case (case_no, title, category, sub_category, region, county_code, county_name, street_code, street_name, content, measure_plan, measure_result, source, status, vector_id) VALUES (#{caseNo}, #{title}, #{category}, #{subCategory}, #{region}, #{countyCode}, #{countyName}, #{streetCode}, #{streetName}, #{content}, #{measurePlan}, #{measureResult}, #{source}, #{status}, #{vectorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE warning_case SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, sub_category = #{subCategory}, region = #{region}, county_code = #{countyCode}, county_name = #{countyName}, street_code = #{streetCode}, street_name = #{streetName}, content = #{content}, measure_plan = #{measurePlan}, measure_result = #{measureResult}, status = #{status}, vector_id = #{vectorId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_case WHERE case_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
